entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi, Alex. Um, I'm not really sure what to do. I bought some... some cycling shoes a while back, and I think I need to send them back. The website was a little overwhelming.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so... hold on. It's... VF... 7... 2... 9... 1... 0. Is that right? I just don't understand any of this. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 53 days ago. What specifically is the issue with them?

They just... they hurt. I tried to set up the cleats, but I don't think I did it right, and my first ride gave me terrible blisters. I'm just so confused by them and I'd really just like a refund if that's possible.
I understand. Getting blisters is no fun at all, and setting up cleats can be tricky the first time. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope it's okay. It's been a little while.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've checked the policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried I was stuck with them. You've been a great help.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just package the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That sounds easy enough. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
